question:
I'm putting together a simple dashboard page for a small internal tool and need help with both the UI references and the architecture drawing.  
    Could you find a clean icon that represents a "statistics overview", show me the documentation and a couple of examples for the Ant Design Card component, and then generate a small architecture diagram that shows:  
    - a frontend module using that Card component,  
    - a backend API service,  
    - and a data storage layer?  
    Keep the diagram high-level.
answer:
Here's everything you asked for — the icon, the Card references, and the diagram. --- ## 1. Icon: `chart-analysis` (statistics overview) Searched for `statistics / overview / analytics / dashboard` and found `/search` returning nothing useful until I split the query; the best semantic fit is **`chart-analysis`** (category: *business*, v3.3.0), whose tags are `analysis · chart · data · graph · trend · business · report · statistics` — it reads as "a chart being analyzed," which is exactly a stats-overview tile. **Glyph:** `󱤍` (decimal `989453`) — identical across all styles, so you pick the look independently of the codepoint. | Style | Best for | |---|---| | `stroke-rounded` | Default for internal tools; pairs cleanly with Ant Design's 1.5px strokes | | `twotone-rounded` | Card headers where you want a soft accent | | `solid-rounded` | Small stat tiles / KPI chips where strokes get muddy | | `bulk-rounded` | Dense dashboards with heavy visual weight | **React usage** ```tsx import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react'; import { ChartAnalysisIcon } from '@hugeicons-pro/core-stroke-rounded'; ``` Install: `npm install @hugeicons/react` plus the icon package. ⚠️ **One caveat worth knowing before you commit:** `chart-analysis` lives in the **Pro** icon sets (`@hugeicons-pro/*`), so it needs the licensed registry in your `.npmrc`. The only freely available package is `@hugeicons/core-free-icons`. If you'd rather not add a license to a small internal tool, these alternatives came up in the same search and are all statistics-flavoured — swap the import and the usage is otherwise identical: - **`bar-chart`** — tags include `statistics, analytics, metrics, dashboard` (closest free-feeling match) - **`pie-chart`** — `data visualization, analytics, statistics, metric` - **`chart-03`** — `line chart, trend, analytics` - **`analytics-03`** — `bar chart, statistics, dashboard, metrics, histogram` --- ## 2. Ant Design `Card` ### Docs summary A basic container for text, lists, images, and paragraphs — the docs explicitly call it out as *"commonly used on admin overview pages,"* which is your use case. ```jsx Card content ``` Key props for a dashboard: | Prop | Notes | |---|---| | `title` | Card heading (`ReactNode`) | | `extra` | Top-right action area — put "More" or a range picker here | | `loading` | Renders a text-block skeleton until data arrives — ideal for async stats | | `hoverable` | Lifts on hover | | `size` | `default` \| `small` | | `variant` | `outlined` \| `borderless` — **requires antd ≥ 5.24.0** | | `actions` | Bottom action group, `Array` | | `cover` | Cover image/content | | `tabList` / `activeTabKey` / `onTabChange` | Tabs inside the card | | `type="inner"` | Nested card for multi-level info | | `classNames` / `styles` | Semantic-DOM styling (object **or** function of props) | Sub-components: **`Card.Meta`** (`avatar`, `title`, `description`) and **`Card.Grid`** (`hoverable`, default `true`). > `bordered` is **deprecated** in favour of `variant`. ### Example A — the grid layout you actually want Straight from the docs' "栅格卡片" sample, which is designed for system overview pages: ```tsx import { Card, Col, Row } from 'antd'; 1,284 312 0.4% ``` ### Example B — with header action + loading skeleton Combining the "典型卡片" and "预加载的卡片" samples, which is what a real metric tile looks like while fetching: ```tsx import { Card, Skeleton } from 'antd'; More} loading={isLoading} style={{ width: 300 }} >

Total events: 48,201

Unique sessions: 3,940

Avg. duration: 2m 14s

 ``` ### Example C — tabbed card (multiple stat views in one tile) ```tsx Export} > {activeKey === 'day' ? : } ``` --- ## 3. Architecture diagram ![PlantUML Diagram](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/svg/JP0nJyD038Nt-nKcB31Kh8W1DKqQ5OOIATqAWvkuoQcNkyZdDgeG_nsdC4IU_3w_PylBACXoxfsvauvwWi6XzIQUh1-GiOSwz4FmvAMIgoDWgWLzwsWs4ZjimcXz2qTqSKuQEkBPIH6yR573D-Gk9BR6sKpA7COikC1m_vnDPSo0zGbRWgHWjP9l4lWs0FiSOtS8o0sKYZ_zG-e5SegszP2f_FW56A5OcnzZzYiDKIkavHjKn1TRqmrhFzkGeo1K4bYxlosDAWUCoagsFV8LydybcUpvQaelrh1OlDwoNs2psvKLFC5xzR4rapIXVAM42Hi58riXizHhzDE_ Three nodes, two edges, no internal detail — high-level as requested: ```plantuml @startuml !theme plain skinparam componentStyle rectangle skinparam shadowing false skinparam defaultFontName Helvetica skinparam ArrowColor #8C8C8C package "Frontend" { [Dashboard Page\n(Ant Design Card)] as FE } [Backend API Service] as API package "Data Storage" { database "Primary Database" as DB } FE --> API : HTTPS / JSON API --> DB : read / write @enduml ``` **Reading it:** the frontend package contains only the dashboard page, labelled with the Card component since that's the UI primitive in question. It talks HTTPS/JSON to a single backend API service, which owns all reads and writes to the storage layer — the frontend never touches the database directly. That one rule is the thing worth keeping if this diagram ever grows. ### Suggested next steps - Decide on the icon licensing question early — it's the only real blocker here. If Pro is off the table, `bar-chart` is the drop-in. - If you're on antd `5.23.x` or older, use `bordered={false}` instead of `variant="borderless"` in the examples above. - The diagram deliberately stops at one database box; add a cache or queue later only when there's a concrete read-pressure reason.

Card 组件的文档：
## 何时使用
最基础的卡片容器，可承载文字、列表、图片、段落，常用于后台概览页面。
## API
```jsx
<Card title="卡片标题">卡片内容</Card>
```
| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | 卡片操作组，位置在卡片底部 | Array<ReactNode> | - |  |
| activeTabKey | 当前激活页签的 key | string | - |  |
| ~~bordered~~ | 是否有边框, 请使用 `variant` 替换 | boolean | true |  |
| variant | 形态变体 | `outlined` \| `borderless` \| | `outlined` | 5.24.0 |
| classNames | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> | - |  |
| cover | 卡片封面 | ReactNode | - |  |
| defaultActiveTabKey | 初始化选中页签的 key，如果没有设置 activeTabKey | string | `第一个页签的 key` |  |
| extra | 卡片右上角的操作区域 | ReactNode | - |  |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起 | boolean | false |  |
| loading | 当卡片内容还在加载中时，可以用 loading 展示一个占位 | boolean | false |  |
| size | card 的尺寸 | `default` \| `small` | `default` |  |
| tabBarExtraContent | tab bar 上额外的元素 | ReactNode | - |  |
| tabList | 页签标题列表 | [TabItemType](/components/tabs-cn#tabitemtype)[] | - |  |
| tabProps | [Tabs](/components/tabs-cn#tabs) | - | - |  |
| title | 卡片标题 | ReactNode | - |  |
| type | 卡片类型，可设置为 `inner` 或 不设置 | string | - |  |
| styles | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> | - |  |
| onTabChange | 页签切换的回调 | (key) => void | - |  |
### Card.Grid
| 参数      | 说明                   | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| className | 网格容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起       | boolean       | true   |      |
| style     | 定义网格容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
### Card.Meta
| 参数        | 说明               | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| avatar      | 头像/图标          | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| className   | 容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| description | 描述内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| style       | 定义容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
| title       | 标题内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |

如有版本说明需要提醒用户需要使用某个版本及以上的版本
